public_repository_rules: Never commit the 64MB registry-source workbook, original J-Blue PDFs, personal account identifiers, original detailed serial tables or business-sensitive evidence without rights review.
CC BY 4.0 Berkeley project summaries may be locally normalized with attribution; generated NDJSON is not proof of live issuance, custody or transfer permission.
Always preserve source SHA-256 and snapshot date. Missing fields remain null. Never equate serial count with tCO2e without a regime-specific denomination.
No registry or token contract permission is inferred from public source disclosure.
